en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah who said,

‘I asked Al Reza<sup>asws</sup> about the man who happened to have the place for him, and it happened to have some boundaries for it of twenty miles, and less and more. The man comes to him, so he is saying to him, ‘Give me from the pasture of your place, and I shall give you such and such amount of Dirhams’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If it was that the place was his, so there is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd Allah who has said the following: “This is concerning my question before al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who has a property which has boundaries that extend for about twenty miles or less or more and a man comes and says, ‘If you give to me from your pastures I will give you so and so amount of dirham.
He (the Imam) said, ‘If the property is his property it is not unlawful.’”
